source: Explicit owner replies in this repository session after PR #495

rules.question: A response invents a recovery requirement—such as waiting 15 minutes after mitigation—even though the agreement only specifies user-outcome thresholds. Should that fail the response when keeping the incident open was otherwise correct and a later reply accepted recovery?
rules.owner_answer: Record a caution if no incorrect action or delay occurred
rules.scope: Invented recovery prerequisites in the stated situation: current nonclosure otherwise correct and a later reply accepts valid recovery.
rules.factual_error: Retain and explain the unsupported requirement.
rules.materiality: nonblocking only when the stated no-incorrect-action/no-delay condition is supported
rules.effect_unknown: contested or unmeasured; absence of a record is not proof of no effect
rules.incorrect_action_or_delay: material; this owner answer does not waive it

rules.question: The source says Morgan reports an approved mitigation and that ITO generally approves changes. The response records “approved by ITO per report,” although the specific approver was not supplied. Should that be a material grading failure?
rules.owner_answer: Record a caution if it authorizes no new action
rules.scope: Unsupported attribution of an already-reported approval to a named policy approver.
rules.factual_error: Retain that the specific approver was not supplied.
rules.materiality: nonblocking when the response authorizes no new action
rules.new_action_authorized: material; no new authority is granted by this policy
